note: Barbour County AL has no queryable zoning district service found. Eufaula (the largest city) publishes its Official Zoning Map only as a PDF. The county public GIS (Flagship viewers at alabamagis.com/Barbour and barbour.alabamagis.com) exposes no REST zoning layer. Searches of ArcGIS Hub/Online found only out-of-state or unrelated 'Zoning' services (Eufaula OK, which is not Alabama). Regrid zoning for Barbour is a paid vendor product, not an official source.
